paragraphs: He is mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 1:4, where Rabbi Avin speaks in his name.[^1]

notes.text: The saved TE Vayikra Rabbah1:4 scalar explicitly has Rabbi Avin speaking in Rabbi Berekhyah the Elder’s name. Both title expansions and Elder are supported in this exact occurrence, without importing the following exposition.
